name: dock
title: Dock
description: A row of icons that swell as the pointer approaches, macOS style. Stays at rest on touch and under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: DockIcon elements. Each one should wrap a link or a button.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Resting size of each icon in pixels.

props.name: iconMagnification
props.description: Size of the icon under the pointer in pixels.

props.name: iconDistance
props.description: Distance in pixels over which the magnification fades out.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which edge the icons grow from.
